recognize_zh: 四格對照圖：1A/1B（室溫處理）紅血球分布均勻、形態大致正常；2A/2B（檢體置 4 °C 後）低倍可見紅血球聚成不規則團塊（autoagglutination），高倍紅血球互相重疊成群並伴皺縮，提示冷凝集素造成的凝集。
features: Composite of four peripheral blood smear panels labeled 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B
1A-1B: evenly dispersed red cells with largely normal shape; a segmented neutrophil in 1B
2A (after 4 C incubation): low-power irregular clumping of red cells into agglutinates with uneven distribution
2B: red cells in overlapping irregular clusters, many crenated (echinocytic) cells, limiting morphologic assessment
Scattered platelets in all panels; no rouleaux stacking pattern
describe_en: This composite shows peripheral blood smears prepared before (1A, 1B) and after (2A, 2B) incubation of the sample at 4 C. The initial smears show evenly spread red cells with essentially unremarkable morphology at low and high power. After cold incubation, the low-power view shows irregular three-dimensional red cell clumps, and the high-power view shows overlapping clusters of red cells with crenation, obscuring fine red cell morphology. The cold-dependent red cell agglutination, in the setting of macrocytic hemolytic anemia and acrocyanosis, is suggestive of cold agglutinin disease, to be confirmed by a positive C3d direct antiglobulin test and cold agglutinin titer.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear stacks like coins that disperse with saline, whereas agglutinates are irregular grape-like clusters that persist with saline and reverse on warming.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes with an IgG-positive DAT and no temperature-dependent clumping.
PCH is caused by a biphasic IgG Donath-Landsteiner antibody, usually in children, and typically shows erythrophagocytosis rather than prominent agglutination.
Artifactual echinocytes are evenly distributed and not clustered, and they do not appear only after cold exposure of the sample.
